edges.reason: Constructor assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable.
modules[msg.sender] is read to decide module authorization.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner to gate execution.
onlyFromModule checks modules[msg.sender] before allowing execution.
setup writes _initialOwner into the _owner slot.
setOwner writes newOwner into the _owner slot.
setup casts _controller and stores it in the controller slot.
setController stores newController in the controller slot.
addModuleInternal sets modules[_module] = true.
removeModule deletes modules[_module].
bindMethod writes the methodToModule entry keyed by _method.
bindMethod writes the _module address into methodToModule[_method].
mode selects the CALL branch of nonReentrantCall.
to parameter is the destination of the low-level call.
value parameter is the ETH forwarded with the call.
data parameter is the calldata forwarded in the call.
mode parameter of nonReentrantCall selects the CALL branch.
target parameter is used as the call destination.
value parameter is forwarded with the call.
data parameter is forwarded to the call.
target parameter is used as the delegatecall destination.
data parameter is forwarded to delegatecall.
target parameter is used as the staticcall destination.
data parameter is forwarded to staticcall.
Fallback resolves the target module from methodToModule[msg.sig].
Fallback validates modules[module] before dispatching the call.
owner() returns the _owner storage value.
transact reads controller to query the ModuleRegistry.
transact calls moduleRegistry().isModuleRegistered(to) to block module targets.
The resolved module local is the callee of the fallback low-level call.
The success flag is produced by the low-level call.
The returnData buffer is produced by the low-level call.
onlyOwner gates transferOwnership.
onlyOwner gates renounceOwnership.
onlyFromModule gates setOwner.
onlyFromModule gates setController.
onlyFromModule gates removeModule.
onlyFromModule gates bindMethod.
onlyFromModule gates transact.
Fallback requires modules[module] to authorize the delegated call.
setup is protected by the nonReentrant guard.
setOwner is protected by the nonReentrant guard.
setController is protected by the nonReentrant guard.
transact delegates to the guarded nonReentrantCall.
nonReentrantCall carries the nonReentrant modifier directly.
The modifier writes and resets _guardValue to block reentrant entry.
addModule forwards _module to addModuleInternal.
removeModule calls Module(_module).deactivate() inside try/catch.
transact performs its external calls through nonReentrantCall.
addModuleInternal invokes Module(_module).activate().
nonReentrantCall performs target.call when mode == 1.
nonReentrantCall performs target.delegatecall when mode == 2.
nonReentrantCall performs target.staticcall when mode == 3.
The module low-level call can re-enter the wallet fallback before state settles.
Module.activate() is invoked before the module flag is fully committed, allowing callbacks into the wallet.
Module.deactivate() executes while removal is in progress and can callback into the wallet.
The forwarded target.call may re-enter the transact / nonReentrant guarded path.
delegatecall executes arbitrary code in the wallet context and may re-enter the fallback.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner parameter is only meaningful inside transferOwnership, so fold it into that function node.
_controller parameter is consumed by setup when writing the controller slot.
_initialOwner parameter is consumed by setup when writing the _owner slot.
newOwner parameter is consumed by setOwner when writing the _owner slot.
newController parameter is consumed by setController when writing the controller slot.
_module parameter enters through addModule and flows to addModuleInternal.
_module parameter is used by removeModule to delete the modules entry.
_method parameter keys the methodToModule mapping written by bindMethod.
_module parameter is the value stored in methodToModule by bindMethod.
mode parameter originates at transact and selects the downstream call opcode.
to parameter originates at transact and becomes the external call target.
value parameter originates at transact and is forwarded as ETH.
data parameter originates at transact and is forwarded as calldata.
mode parameter is consumed by nonReentrantCall to branch between call variants.
target parameter is the destination of the low-level external calls.
value parameter is forwarded as ETH in the low-level call.
data parameter is the calldata forwarded to the low-level calls.
success local is the boolean result of the unsafe target.call operation.
returnData local is the byte buffer returned by the unsafe target.call operation.
module local is resolved inside the fallback and is used only for its dispatch call.
